svg.title: Chatham VII: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Chatham VII identified by Foundation EK458 caption in four-work installation view; center work nearly frontal. Approximate panel ratios, no inferred physical dimensions.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-chatham-series/; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
